name: deepx_auto_chain_scene
description: Autonomous Video Analyzer & Scene Chainer: Detects the latest completed video tile on Google Flow, extracts its terminal end frame in memory via HTMLCanvas, uploads it via DataTransfer as a continuity anchor, stacks additional references, injects the next scene prompt, and immediately submits generation in under 1.5 seconds.

next_prompt.description: The prompt text for the next scene to generate.

reference_assets.description: Optional additional reference assets to stack alongside the terminal frame.
